translator_notes: Origin unclear; a gurbet (emigrant) style song. 'мој'та / мојта' means 'my' with the definite article attached.

lines.cyr: Збогум и прости мој роден крај,
lines.lat: Zbogum i prosti moj roden kraj,
lines.en: Farewell and forgive me, my native land,
I am going to a foreign land, I am leaving paradise.
My native land, garden of paradise,

lines.cyr: тешка е со тебе мој'та разделба.
lines.lat: teška e so tebe moj'ta razdelba.
lines.en: hard is my parting from you.
There are rich lands in this world,
but none as beautiful as you.
My native land, garden of paradise,

lines.cyr: тешка е со тебе мојта разделба.
lines.lat: teška e so tebe mojta razdelba.
lines.en: hard is my parting from you.

lines.cyr: Каде да одам, пак ќе се вратам,
lines.lat: Kade da odam, pak ḱe se vratam,
lines.en: Wherever I go, I will come back again,

lines.cyr: тука се родив, тука да умрам.
lines.lat: tuka se rodiv, tuka da umram.
lines.en: I was born here, here I want to die.
My native land, garden of paradise,

lines.cyr: тешка е со тебе мојта разделба.
lines.lat: teška e so tebe mojta razdelba.
lines.en: hard is my parting from you.
